title: Amp, which aims to buy excess computing capacity from data center operators to sell to startups, universities, and more, raised $1.3B from a16z and others (Cade Metz/New York Times)
summary: Cade Metz / New York Times: Amp, which aims to buy excess computing capacity from data center operators to sell to startups, universities, and more, raised $1.3B from a16z and others — The world's leading artificial intelligence companies are spending hundreds of billions of dollars on the computer data centers needed to create A.I.
